releases.name: v0.1.0 - initial release
releases.body:
Nine portable Agent Skills for stateful codebase audits, zero-regression TDD remediation, documentation drift and behavioral product design.

Install:

npx github:mihaimyh/agentic-audit-suite install

Targets: Codex (~/.agents/skills), Claude Code (~/.claude/skills), Cursor (~/.cursor/skills), GitHub Copilot (~/.copilot/skills), Google Antigravity (~/.gemini/config/skills), OpenCode (~/.config/opencode/commands).

Highlights:
- audit-init / audit-next / audit-status / audit-final / audit-reset stateful pipeline
- fix-init / fix-next severity-ordered TDD remediation with atomic local commits
- docs-audit drift report, ux-plan behavioral design review
- zero-dependency installer with manifest-based uninstall
- OpenCode server plugin and Claude Code marketplace manifests
